+## reference · Ahrefs 75K Brand Study: Brand Mentions vs. Backlinks for AI Visibility
+
+*   **Core Correlation (Google AI Overviews):** In Ahrefs' 2025 study of 75,000 brands (Domain Rating > 40), branded web mentions correlate with AI visibility at **0.664** (Spearman), while backlinks correlate at only **0.218**. Brand mentions are ~3x more predictive of AI visibility than backlinks.
+*   **Cross-Platform Correlations (Follow-up Study):**
+    *   **YouTube Mentions:** Strongest single signal across ChatGPT, AI Mode, and AI Overviews at **~0.737**.
+    *   **Branded Web Mentions:** AI Mode **0.709**, AI Overviews **0.664**, ChatGPT **0.656**.
+    *   **Backlinks/URL Rating:** Show very weak correlations across all three systems.
+*   **Quartile Impact:** Brands in the top quartile for web mentions received ~169 AI Overview mentions, compared to ~14 mentions for the next quartile (>10x difference).
+*   **Source of Citations:** Muck Rack analysis of 1M+ AI prompts indicates **85.5%** of AI citations originate from earned media (third-party sources), not brand-owned websites.
+*   **AI Traffic ROI:**
+    *   **Ahrefs Data:** AI search traffic accounted for **0.5%** of total traffic but drove **12.1%** of signups (conversion rate ~23x higher than organic).
+    *   **Semrush Data:** Each AI referral visit is valued at **4.4x** the value of a standard organic visit.
+*   **Methodology Note:** Study uses Spearman rank correlation. Correlation does not prove causation (strong brands are mentioned more and appear in AI answers due to shared awareness/relevance), but it confirms the shift in explanatory power from link graphs to brand context.
+*   **LLM Mechanism:** LLMs derive brand authority from semantic context and co-occurrence (word proximity to topics/competitors) rather than hyperlink authority. **Unlinked mentions** are high-value signals for AI visibility, unlike in traditional SEO.
+*   **YouTube Strategy for GEO:**
+    *   YouTube transcripts are rich text sources directly processed by Google AI systems.
+    *   **Action:** Ensure brand, product, and industry terms are explicitly spoken in video audio (not just in titles/descriptions) to create clear co-occurrence signals.
+    *   Repurpose webinars and expert explainers with clean, keyword-rich transcripts.
+*   **Key Metric:** **Share of Model** – measures frequency, prominence, and sentiment of brand appearance in AI answers relative to competitors.
+*   **DACH Market Context:**
+    *   Germany: 50% of internet users (16+) use AI chats occasionally; 12% use them mostly/exclusively (Bitkom).
+    *   Austria: ~70% of consumers use AI services, even if rarely (Reppublika/Handelsverband).
+
 Sources: https://blckalpaca.at/en/knowledge-base/seo-geo/geo-generative-engine-optimization/brand-mentions-vs-backlinks-the-ahrefs-75k-brand-study
